...אני ורבי ישראל בצפת, אז ניסים שאני חי, שאני יושב פה הוא היה צריך לשחוט אותו

"ברסלב”

אה.. אה, אה

segments.en:
Rebbe Yisroel (Kardonner) was in great danger, he took an iron chair and wanted to strike him on the head; Hashem Yisborach had mercy, and people came, they took the chair, and he remained alive

But he died on Saturday night, my father-in-law died on Shabbos morning, and on the night..

On the night of Saturday night was the funeral

The funer.., the funeral of {Rebbe Yisroel}...

…{..}...

… “I will kill you, you, you are killing my daughter, I will kill you” there was.. opponents of Breslov took a large knife and said:

“We will slaughter them all”

[Was this on Lag BaOmer?]

Eh?

[On Lag BaOmer?]

Yes, they were in great danger

They said that they would slaughter us

…[..…]

...{…}...

...I and Rebbe Yisroel in Tzfas, so it is miracles that I am alive, that I am sitting here; he had to slaughter him

"Breslov”

Ah.. ah, ah

Oy vey, oy, the legs on the bed…
